description: This Java class 'VersionComparator' provides a comparator for version strings, comparing them numerically based on dot-separated tokens to correctly order version numbers like '10' after '9'.

classes.name: VersionComparator
classes.description: A comparator class for comparing version strings numerically, ensuring correct ordering of version numbers.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two version strings by delegating to ModuleUtil.compareVersion, ensuring numeric comparison rather than lexicographic.
